headline.tier: Grounded-language faculty COMPLETE end-to-end: a SPIKING fluent LLM (converted Qwen2.5-0.5B, T=16) speaks the BRAIN's grounded knowledge, hallucination-proof by construction. The composer GATES (speak only when the brain has the content), the spiking faculty RENDERS fluent prose, and the parser VERIFIES (re-parses the output, rejects role-inverted drift). The no-confab moat holds WITH a real generative LLM in the loop.
headline.metrics: grounded 4/4 fluent-correct, untaught 2/2 abstain, adversarial drift 1/1 caught (the 0.5B LLM inverted a role -> VERIFY rejected -> regen -> faithful); T=16 ppl 1.08x ANN; whole demo 22.9 s
headline.wall_clock: 22.9 s (~0.3-1.2 s/generation greedy); brain SIM_BACKEND=numpy CPU + faculty PyTorch on the 3090; NO sim/ edit
headline.summary: P1 (spiking fluent faculty) + P2 (brain learns + recalls + abstains) + P3 (gate->constrain->verify) COMBINED into a working end-to-end demo. The LLM supplies fluency; the brain supplies + verifies content; hallucination is caught by construction. In parallel, the artificial-life DEVELOP loop runs at GPU scale with REAL stream-cortex Hebbian learning: over simulated days the brain develops (vocab 6->24, facts 2->11, recall 1.0, retention 1.0, moat 0-FA), persists + resumes between days, frozen-brain anti-cheat holds; a compressed 'week' = ~16 min, a 'year' an overnight local run (2026-06-23-longitudinal-develop-loop-GPU-GO.md). Honest scope: both at de-risk / 1-seed scale; curriculum scaling + bridge consolidation are the strengthening follow-ons.

capacity_rule.rule: Empirical motor-pool / encoding-axis capacity rule (REVISED 2026-05-10): the encoding-axis architecture is recommended for vocab >= 32. Motor capacity matters less than encoding capacity at higher tiers; encoding (n_lang_input) is rate-limiting, the motor pool just needs ~125 neurons/sub-pop for STDP convergence. Superseded at scale by the G.20 sparse-distributed + flat-distinct 320-concept route (see pillars); kept as the small-vocab reference.
